positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Google Cloud data center capacity forecasting. Optimizing data center hardware orders at world scale (CPUs, GPUs, RAM, SSD, networking components).
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Software Design and +6 skills

positions.title: Back-End Software Engineer - Publisher Content Systems
positions.description:
- Reduced Scribd's yearly tax bill by leading design and implementation of the value-add tax deduction system. Delegated tasks to several cross functional teams, coordinated implementation timelines, and timed release with stakeholders to comply with legal requirements.
- Decreased hundreds of thousands of dollars of overspending by designing and creating Scribd's payout cost data transfer pipeline. Used Spark and Redis task queued jobs to process millions of user wallet data nightly. 
- Doubled recommendation surfacing speed by redesigning relational database indices and caching strategies for content categorization systems. Created efficient ingestion, update, and archive life cycle components for Scribd's categorization system.

positions.title: Front-End Software Engineer - Web
positions.description:
- Decreased subscription churn by developing web A/B tests and all browser compatible web features. 
- Brought Scribd up to ADA accessibility compliance by converting legacy rendering templates into reusable, accessible React components. 
- Standardized Scribd's company-wide JavaScript standards by hosting weekly information sessions and lint rule voting rounds. 
- Decreased JavaScript errors in production, automated code quality check, and improved developer productivity by integrating linting and automatic formatting to codebases and CI pipelines.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - Web
positions.description:
- Developed and implemented multiple features for Strateo's experiments page.
- Reduced load time for Strateos's most trafficked web page by 50% with pagination and  asynchronous data fetch.

positions.title: Research Analyst
positions.description:
- Studied the mechanism-of-action (MOA) of multiple chronic pain modalities in veterans including mild Traumatic Brain Injury-related Headaches and Chronic Nerve Pain. 
- Contributed to 2 research studies to test new therapies, and developed data processing skills.
